Interesting: B = cos²ψ(1+ε/R) − ε/R = 2.56. With ε>0 (stretched): B ≤ 1+ε/R − ε/R = 1 for ψ=0, and B can exceed 1 only if... cos²ψ(1+ε/R) − ε/R ≤ 1 requires... e.g. ψ=0 gives 1 exactly; ψ≠0 gives less. So B ≤ 1 always?! Then B=2.56 is impossible. Contradiction!

Right: the balance is S_11θ + S_12θ_j... = k_dL(γ − Lθ) so γ = [θ(S_11+k_dL²) + S_12θ_j]/(k_dL).
